overallReport.headline: Riley leads on both average views and average likes.

findings.text: Riley leads the field with a clear margin in average views and a clear margin in average likes.
Average views are tightly grouped while average likes are spread out.
Both total views and total likes follow upload volume.

caveats: David has 1 upload, so that ranking is uncertain.
Brad has 2 uploads, so that ranking is uncertain.
overallReport.interpretation: Interpretation: These findings reflect observations drawn directly from video metrics rather than definitive proof of audience sentiment.
